decisions.decision: One Session per server process (global in-memory). v0.01 is single-user, localhost-only.
inputs: spec: no persistent history across restarts

alternatives_considered.reason_rejected: out of scope for v0.01; adds auth-adjacent complexity

decisions.weighting_logic: Keep the surface area of 'a session' tiny; punt multi-session to v0.1 or later.

decisions.decision: /api/files and /api/file return HTML (htmx-native) rather than JSON as spec hints
inputs: spec says 'JSON tree' for /api/files; htmx swaps HTML by default

alternatives_considered.reason_rejected: adds a client-side renderer (and either hand-written JS or a template lib); spec explicitly wants 'no build step'

decisions.weighting_logic: If htmx is the chosen frontend, HTML responses are the path of least friction. Re-reading spec, it says 'htmx for streaming and dynamic updates' — HTML responses are coherent with that. I'm overriding the literal 'JSON tree' in favor of the surrounding architecture.
decisions.downstream_impact: If a different UI is ever plugged in, these endpoints would need JSON variants. Easy to add.

decisions.decision: Vanilla EventSource + JS for SSE token-appending, not htmx's sse extension
inputs: htmx's sse-swap replaces the target's innerHTML on each named event; we want to append, not replace

alternatives_considered.reason_rejected: brittle in htmx 2.x — sse-swap prefers replace; getting append semantics right required hacks

decisions.weighting_logic: 30 lines of vanilla JS is less code than the workaround. htmx still handles the form POST and DOM fragment swap on send.
decisions.downstream_impact: If we ever want partial-render replacements on SSE (e.g., live file tree push), we can layer htmx-sse back on.

decisions.decision: Tool-call boundary is the end of </tool>: stop streaming there, record assistant message up to that point, execute, resume in a new turn.
inputs: spec: 'tool use loop'; 'append result as next message'

alternatives_considered.option: let model finish its whole response, then execute all tool calls at once
alternatives_considered.reason_rejected: model will hallucinate post-tool text based on imagined results

alternatives_considered.option: execute inline without breaking assistant turn boundary
alternatives_considered.reason_rejected: tool result as user message is cleaner for the model's mental model

decisions.weighting_logic: Turn boundary at </tool> matches how chat-format tool use actually works in practice. aclose() on the upstream async generator cleanly terminates the httpx stream.

decisions.decision: Drop reasoning_content from the default stream
inputs: empirical: initial smoke test streamed all of Gemma 4's thinking into the UI; 1021 chars of noise before the 150-char answer
OpenAI-compat API convention: reasoning_content is on a separate channel precisely so clients can ignore it

alternatives_considered.option: render reasoning as collapsible UI block
alternatives_considered.reason_rejected: spec says plain transcript style; add UI complexity for a v0.1 feature
feeds back into history on tool-loop turns — model sees its own prior scratchpad in context, confusing

decisions.weighting_logic: The reasoning_content channel exists to be ignored. Surfacing it is an explicit UI feature for later.
decisions.downstream_impact: For v0.1, add a UI toggle + separate SSE event type for reasoning tokens.

decisions.decision: Added python-multipart to deps (missed in initial pyproject)
inputs: empirical: POST /api/chat 500'd with AssertionError on starlette form parsing

alternatives_considered.reason_rejected: spec says 'hx-post' on the form, which defaults to form-encoding; keep it conventional

decisions.weighting_logic: Add the tiny dep and move on.

decisions.decision: llama_server.sh takes MODEL from env; no default path baked in
inputs: script lives at repo root (prod); can't assume user's model path

alternatives_considered.option: default MODEL to a path that probably won't exist, let start fail with the not-found message

decisions.weighting_logic: Fail fast with a clear message beats fail silently.

decisions.decision: README includes a /reset endpoint UI not mentioned in the spec
inputs: testing the tool loop across multiple messages made me want a 'clear history' button without restarting the server

alternatives_considered.reason_rejected: the UX without it is annoying; you have to kill the server to clear the conversation

decisions.weighting_logic: Add small QOL touches that don't expand scope (reset is ~5 lines of server code).
